# Input/output labels for the benchmark programs, written before the
# I/O benchmark was first run.
#
# program  save  stdout
#
# save: how "Save output to file" should work.
#   capture     Mint saves what the program prints (its results)
#   log         it prints only messages; its real output goes elsewhere
#   positional  it writes the file named by its last argument (ffmpeg)
#   -o|--output the option it writes its output file through (aliases joined by |)
# stdout: results, log or binary.
# "/" separates answers that are equally right; "skip" marks programs
# that only run full-screen (htop), which no generated app wraps.
sysctl capture results
timedatectl capture results
hostnamectl capture results
gsettings capture results
